status: SUPERSEDED, NOT AUTHORISED — replaced by pilot-plan-v2.json (D-198); no image call may ever be sent on this file. Its at most 24 calls were never approved.
purpose: prove that GPT-drawn garments fit the ONE fixed Northstar v2 body through the tools (registration, extraction, layer split, gates) — not through prompts — and measure how many pass without retouching

model.name: gpt-image-2-2026-04-21
model.background: opaque (transparent output is refused by this model — D-151)

inputs.image1: the category's reference picture from `node tools/avatar/northstar-wardrobe-poc.mjs --out <dir>` → ref-top.png / ref-pants.png / ref-shoes.png: the base figure wearing the category's default, every other category clipped to its guaranteed core, on the flat magenta key #FF00FF
inputs.privacy: the reference pictures contain the clothed Northstar figure only; never a bare or close-fitting body; H1 is never sent or used

calls.retryBudget: at most 1 retry per item and only after a TECHNICAL rejection (registration or I1–I5), never for taste

promptTemplate: Edit this picture. Repaint ONLY the {noun} the boy is wearing, as: {description}. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the same boy, face, hair, skin, arms, hands, pose, position and size, the other clothes, and the flat solid magenta background. Paint in exactly the same style as the picture: clean dark outlines, soft cel shading, the same light from the upper left, the same level of detail. {coverage} Do not use magenta or pink-magenta anywhere in the clothing. No text, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks. Everyday, age-appropriate school clothing that covers as much as the current {noun} or more.

coverage.top: The new top must cover at least everything the current T-shirt covers: sleeves at least to the current sleeve ends (longer is fine, ending at the wrists, never over the hands), a crew neckline or higher, the hem at or below the current hem but above the crotch, never tighter than the current T-shirt.
coverage.pants: The new trousers must be full length and cover at least everything the current jeans cover: from the current waistband down to the shoe tops, each leg at least as wide as now; they may be wider and may cover the top of the shoes, never the soles.
coverage.shoes: Both new shoes must stand on exactly the same ground line as the current sneakers and be at least as large as them; ankle height or higher is fine (a boot shaft goes under the trousers).

acceptance.technical: per item: registration (≤ 6 px shift, mean Δ ≤ 6 on the protected figure) and gates I1–I8 of contract-v1 on the EXTRACTED layers, without retouching
acceptance.visual: owner review of every passing item in the outfit at 1:1 and at the app sizes (hub 110×165, quiz 52×78), and of mixed combinations of the pilot items (every top × every pants × every shoe = 64 outfits, rendered automatically)
acceptance.pilotSucceeds: if at least 8 of 12 items pass technically without retouching and the owner accepts their look; otherwise the failure causes decide the next step (prompt, reference picture, envelope or category rule)
